Foundations

Icons

Rounded outline icon set used across the library.

Installation

$pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @paneui/icons

Icon styles

The default set is rounded: outline glyphs on a 24×24 grid with 1.75px round strokes and soft corners. The same names and props also ship in two other styles: puffy (filled shapes on an 18×18 grid) and outline (the puffy shapes as 1.6px outlines). Every style installs tocomponents/icons.tsx, so one command switches every component in your project. Preview them with the toggle under All icons.

$pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://paneui.dev/r/icons-puffy.json --overwrite
$pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://paneui.dev/r/icons-outline.json --overwrite

Back to rounded:

$pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://paneui.dev/r/icons.json --overwrite

Components list the icon set as a dependency, so adding one later asks whether to overwritecomponents/icons.tsx. Answer no (the default) to keep your style. If you add components with--overwrite, the rounded set comes back: run your style's command again afterwards.

Make your own icons

Need a glyph the set doesn't have? Install the puffy-icons agent skill and ask your coding agent for it. The skill carries the drawing rules for every style (grids, primitives, corner radii), reference icons, a preview script to check the result at small sizes, and how to add it to your components/icons.tsx. Works with any coding agent that reads Agent Skills.

$npx skills add QinYangWang/ui --skill puffy-icons
